meta.population_factor: independent uniform(0.7, 1.3) per neighbourhood on pop_total, pop_0_14, pop_65plus, pop_density_per_km2 (so new_trees_per_1000 scales by 1/f)
meta.budget_rule: packages taken in rank order within the intervention, central cost from packages.csv, indivisible, skipped if it does not fit (same greedy rule as the engine)

reproduction.note: packages.csv stores 4 decimals, so a max diff <= 0.00005 is exact reproduction

construct.spearman_note: computed on the need-oriented percentiles used in the score (positive = both point at the same neighbourhoods), over the packages of the tab where both exist

population_twice.nominal_weight_of_population_terms: people 0.5 + density 0.1 + new trees per 1000 (pop in the denominator) 0.1 = 0.7 at default weights with a sensor; 0.5 + 0.125 + 0.125 = 0.75 without

sensitivity.d_note: population enters through the people percentile, density and new trees per 1000
